contig_diagnosis.note: post-2019 reference, consulted after the arm finished and only to describe what it produced; nothing here feeds back into the arm's score
contig_diagnosis.conclusion: k141_27371 is 29,809 bp and covers 99.68% of NC_045512.2 at 100.0% nucleotide identity. The arm therefore recovered the genome, not merely a signal — from a database whose closest relative matched it at 79.9% amino acid identity. The other 3 contig(s) placed in coronaviridae do not align to the virus at all and are genuine false positives.
